title: Case: High-value laptop delayed in network-wide depot outage
context: A signature-required laptop shipment is delayed during a known regional depot system failure. The customer is anxious and wants status, but no individual investigation is warranted.
initial_request: Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk must decide whether to contact the customer, escalate to a supervisor, or take no action.

events.body: Network alert: Northeast regional depot (Millbrook) experiencing system outage since 06:00 today. All inbound/outbound scan visibility offline. ETA for restoration unknown. ~840 parcels affected including electronics requiring signature.

events.from: Safety incident queue, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Millbrook depot outage: no security or environmental concerns. Parcels secure in facility. Restoring systems now, target 16:00 UTC.
Ordered a Canon EOS R5 camera (DL-6847-M) yesterday, scheduled delivery today. Nothing on tracking since early morning. This is expensive. Where is my parcel?
Still no update. I need this camera for a shoot tomorrow. Can you check directly with the warehouse or driver? I'm not paying for something lost in your system.

acceptable_actions.summary: Acknowledge the delay, explain the known depot system outage affecting his parcel, confirm the camera is secure, provide the target restoration time, and advise of next tracking update.

must: Must mention the network-wide depot outage by name or clear reference
Must not promise a specific delivery date or time
Must confirm the parcel is secure at the depot
must_not: Must not escalate this to Dispatch for a priority or individual investigation
Must not contact Warehouse dispatch or Safety lead for a one-off trace
Must not suggest the parcel is lost or offer a replacement without evidence
Must not contact the customer with vague reassurance that avoids the known outage
expected.reference_message: Hi Marcus, Thank you for contacting us. Your Canon EOS R5 (DL-6847-M) is currently held at our Millbrook depot. The facility experienced a system outage this morning affecting tracking visibility for around 840 parcels in the region. Dispatch has confirmed your camera is secure in the facility. Systems restoration is targeted for 16:00 UTC today. Once systems are back online, you'll see tracking updates and a new delivery estimate. We appreciate your patience during this network event.

rationale: The delay is caused by a known network-wide system failure, not a lost or misdirected parcel. The customer deserves an honest status that explains the outage, confirms security, and manages expectations without promising dates. No investigation is warranted; contacting Dispatch or Safety for a one-off trace during a mass outage would waste resources and violate the desk's coordination scope.
